svg.title: WGO · Conversations into living knowledge
svg.desc: Functional view: conversations and legacy knowledge become readable knowledge, search, briefings, follow-ups and resource associations. Semantic workflows require migration and activation; resource delivery, backup and external ingestion retain separate states.

text.tspan: Connect scattered solutions, experiences and stories so you can read,
Semantic source candidate: available after a verified rebuild and activation. This map
does not claim a completed live migration.
Models propose content and changes; the program validates evidence and commits to SQLite.
Notes, views and indexes are rebuildable.
A knowledge page that keeps growing
Follow key statements back to original

using links and embeds, without duplicating

Preferences and queries need no new
The resource path remains · Links, originals, backup and external

and your reading and editing choices.
